name: EntityHeaderSkeleton
description: The header's loading state: the same boxes as the loaded header (R9.3).
signature: ({ subtitle, tabs }: { subtitle?: boolean; tabs?: boolean; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Reserve the subtitle (facts) line, matching a loaded header that has one. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Reserve the tab row, matching a loaded header that has tabs. Defaults to `false`.
